parsed.note_claim: Since 8 January 2026, Iran has been experiencing a widespread internet blackout lasting over 100 days, limiting most citizens' access to the global internet and digital services.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: On 8 January 2026, the twelfth day of the 2025–2026 protests in Iran, Iranian authorities imposed an internet blackout.
parsed.reason: The Wikipedia article confirms the blackout began on 8 January 2026, describes it as nationwide, and details its prolonged duration and severe restrictions on citizens' internet access.
